reuse.why: Extends the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend and introduces isNonWorkingDay in shared/schedules.ts, then routes every existing weekend check (getNextDate, getUpcomingDates, getDatesInRange, schedule-template) through them.

duplication.why: The non-working-day rule is defined once; the only repetition is threading `holidays` through each pre-existing call site and the `3 + holidays.length` window expression written twice in getDatesInRange.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts next to the weekend helper, the type gains the field in types/models/schedule.ts, and rule-utils passes it into the schedule data.

scope.why: Every edit serves holiday support; nothing unrelated.

maintainability.why: One predicate decides weekend-or-holiday, but each caller must remember to pass holidays and the daily-skip branches remain spread across three call sites.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All weekend decisions now go through isNonWorkingDay / getDateWithSkippedWeekend.

one_place.where: isNonWorkingDay in shared/schedules.ts, used by getDateWithSkippedWeekend and by the daily-skip checks in getNextDate, getUpcomingDates and getDatesInRange; schedule-template passes holidays to getDateWithSkippedWeekend.
